explication: DdddOcr is an offline CAPTCHA-recognition SDK with OCR, object detection, and slider matching, also exposed through an optional HTTP/MCP API. The main workflow is image input through the SDK or API, mode dispatch, image/model processing, and a recognition result. The graph includes the documented custom-model and preprocessing capabilities. Relationships are limited to README statements and source-index references; unsampled API and helper implementations are represented conservatively.
